The '''Zug system''',<ref name="SW48">[[Star Wars (1977) 48|''Star Wars'' (1977) 48]]</ref> also listed under the system name '''Aargau''' on some maps,<ref name="EAOC" /> was a nine-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the banking planet of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]], as well as the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] [[Laazrau]], [[Zauhu]], [[Urazuun]], and [[Faargau]]. The [[Z-Gomot Ternbuell Guppat Corporation/Legends|Z-Gomot Ternbuell Guppat Corporation]] was based in the system.
